import csv, json
from collections import Counter
months = Counter(row["month"] for row in csv.DictReader(open("input.csv")))
json.dump(months, open("output.json", "w"))

import csv, json
rows = list(csv.DictReader(open("input.csv")))
average = sum(float(row["discount"]) for row in rows) / len(rows)
json.dump({"average_discount": average}, open("output.json", "w"))
